_comment: The Royal Court & Extended Family (Expansion 1.2, src/engine/court.py): the systems numbers.
The canon cast is data/dynasty.json (Head Writer). This file adds what the cast sheet leaves open (ages, influence,
roles, the starting cabinet), generates the extra relatives and nobles the court needs, and gives every trait its
mechanics. Generated names and petition texts are PROGRAMMER PLACEHOLDERS for the Head Writer to replace.
Stats run 0-10 as on the cast sheet (5 = an ordinary courtier). Loyalty 0-100 drifts `drift` of the way per week to
base[relation] + trait loyalty + office_favour (in office) + (stability - 50) * stability_factor + ruler court_loyalty.
Below treason.threshold a character PLOTS: embezzlement, leaks to the Vosk, assassination, a coup.
cabinet: each office's buff scales with (stat + trait office_bonus - pivot); a vacant office counts as vacant_stat.
traits (ids are the cast-sheet names lower-cased with _): loyalty; office_bonus {office: points}; embezzle (share
of tax revenue skimmed as Minister of Finance); civil_morale_per_week / military_morale_per_week /
stability_per_week (while at court, or as ruler); office_civil_morale_per_week / office_military_morale_per_week
(while in office); court_loyalty, research_bonus, tax (as ruler); plot_detection (as Head of Intelligence);
false_arrest_chance; commander_traits (commanders.json traits when leading a division); front_death_multiplier;
petitions (extra petition tags); plots_coup (may lead a coup); stat_bonus (generated characters).
audiences: every min..max weeks a courtier demands an audience (a modal: grant / deny / ignore). The Lord Protector
may also HOLD COURT (Royal Court screen, A) once every hold_court_cooldown weeks. petitions: {id, title, text,
traits (who asks; 'any' = anyone), grant {label, hint, effects, loyalty}, deny_loyalty, ignore_loyalty}.
Text placeholders: {name} {role} {city} {region}.
succession: Heir, Siblings (eldest first), Cousins (most influential first), Uncles/Aunts. With nobody left, or
after a successful coup: PROTOCOL ZERO: DYNASTIC COLLAPSE.

generate._note: the cast sheet brings 4 relatives; 1-2 siblings and 0-2 cousins make the 5-8 of the brief

ambitious.name: Ambitious
ambitious.description: wants more: offices, lands, the throne itself

loyal.name: Loyal
loyal.description: devoted to the Lord Protector and the House

corrupt.name: Corrupt
corrupt.description: has sticky fingers: skims 4% of the tax revenue as Minister of Finance

genius.name: Genius
genius.description: a brilliant mind (+3 to every stat)

financial_genius.name: Financial Genius
financial_genius.description: counts as 3 points better as Minister of Finance, and knows his worth

beloved.name: Beloved
beloved.description: the people adore her: civil morale +0.1 and stability +0.2 a week while at court

pacifist.name: Pacifist
pacifist.description: presses the Lord Protector for peace talks at every audience

glory_hound.name: Glory-Hound
glory_hound.description: in the field: +15% attack, 15% heavier losses, never retreats willingly

inexperienced.name: Inexperienced
inexperienced.description: twice as likely to be killed leading a division

paranoid.name: Paranoid
paranoid.description: sees plots everywhere: +20% plot detection as Head of Intelligence, but false arrests sour the court

ruthless.name: Ruthless
ruthless.description: in office: military morale +0.05, civil morale -0.05 a week; an aggressive field commander

pragmatic.name: Pragmatic
pragmatic.description: as ruler: deals with anyone (court loyalty +5)

war_weary.name: War-Weary
war_weary.description: as ruler: the people sense it (civil +0.1/wk), the generals resent it (military -0.1/wk)

petitions.title: A Claim to Confiscated Estates
petitions.text: {name}, {role}, requests an audience. Internal Security confiscated the estates of a Vosk-born timber merchant in {region}; {name} asks that they be granted to the petitioner 'in recognition of loyal service'.

grant.label: Grant the estates
grant.hint: Land costs the Treasury nothing — this time.

petitions.title: Debts in Iren
petitions.text: {name} arrives pale and unshaven. Gambling debts of thirty thousand at the tables of the Iren Free Port — and the creditors are threatening to sell the story to the Oakhaven press.

petitions.title: A Laboratory for {name}
petitions.text: {name} lays blueprints across the Lord Protector's desk: a private research institute in Aldmark, staffed with the best young engineers of the Commonwealth. It needs only money.

petitions.title: A Regiment of Guards
petitions.text: {name} asks for the honorary colonelcy of a Guards regiment, with the right to raise a thousand men from the Harrowfen depots under the family colours.

grant.label: Grant the colonelcy
grant.hint: A thousand men lost to the line, a courtier won.

petitions.title: The Grievance of the Landed Houses
petitions.text: {name} speaks for the great landed families: the war taxes are ruining the estates, the tenants are fleeing to the factories, and the Houses expect relief.

grant.label: Cut the land tax
grant.hint: Two points off the tax rate.

petitions.title: Spies Among the Servants
petitions.text: {name} claims to have uncovered a Vosk spy ring among the palace servants and asks for authority — and funds — to purge the household.

petitions.title: A Hospital in the Family Name
petitions.text: {name} wishes to found a hospital in {city} in the name of the House, so that the people may see the family shares their suffering.

grant.label: Found the hospital
grant.hint: The state pays; the House takes the credit.

petitions.title: A Name-Day Banquet
petitions.text: {name} asks for a state banquet in the Great Hall to celebrate a name-day — champagne, an orchestra, and the foreign ambassadors. The newspapers will count the courses while the cities queue for bread.

grant.label: Hold the banquet
grant.hint: The court glitters; the queues grumble.

petitions.title: {name} Asks to Serve
petitions.text: {name} asks for the honour of a field command at the front: 'the family should share the danger of the trenches.' The General Staff is horrified.

grant.label: Promise a command
grant.hint: Give a royal a division from the Military screen (K). Royals never disobey — but they can die.

petitions.title: {name} Pleads for Peace
petitions.text: {name} comes to the Lord Protector's study late at night with a list of the week's dead, and begs that feelers be put out to Karzan through the Vaelish embassy.

grant.label: Put out feelers
grant.hint: The generals will hear of it.
